single_factor: Replace floor(relu(v/theta)) by relu(v/theta) in stem, hidden and head
state: v_next = v_pre - theta * activation.detach(); negative residual retained
readout: Unchanged pre-reset signed voltage, per-class max of two prototypes, one-time bias
activity_regularization: Same rate-squared loss evaluated on continuous threshold-unit activation; reported as activation, not spike count
guards: Same numeric ceilings; positive activation/threshold <=256 is an amplitude budget, not a spike-burst claim
cost: Dense MAC only; continuous activation does not justify spike AC or energy estimates
data: Train-main fitting; Train-dev selection; no Validation/Test/HW-calibration
budget: First experiment is one fresh epoch; no automatic continuation
interpretation: A matched continuous-state diagnostic, not H2-pro conversion or a replacement ANN baseline
